caption: Cheerful Brazilian children's pop song, extremely catchy singalong earworm, warm friendly adult male lead vocal with a kids choir answering the hook, bright and playful, clean polished mix, the hook starts right on the first beat with no intro, every section lasts exactly 4 bars, short repeated chorus, simple melody in small steps, call and response with the kids choir, the last chorus goes up by a whole step (key change), clear Portuguese pronunciation of every word, playful acoustic guitar, hand claps, shaker, xylophone, light bass, animal sound-like vocal ad-libs
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Quem faz assim? Miau, miau!
Quem faz assim? Au, au, au!
Quem faz assim? Muuu, muuu!
Adivinha, adivinha, quem é?

[Verse 1]
O gatinho faz miau, miau,
o cachorrinho faz au, au, au,
a vaquinha faz muuu, muuu,
e o patinho faz quá, quá, quá!

[Chorus]
Quem faz assim? Miau, miau!
Quem faz assim? Au, au, au!
Quem faz assim? Muuu, muuu!

[Verse 2]
O pintinho faz piu, piu,
o sapinho faz ploc, ploc,

[Bridge]
Piu, piu, miau, miau,
au, au, muuu, muuu,
quá, quá, ploc, ploc,
que festa de bichinhos!
